title: SCI.DY.------UNF.PI.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 258 (PR.S(RD)II-12). SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) is the subject; UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and BIA (bi-aitional). From TR: WO-UNF (world unification). From SPT-DY: PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental). From BIA: MT-INFO (multi-information) and EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From PER-VT-U-FUND: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From EXT-FT: C-RH (composite research) and PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental).
